summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 14, 2026 news release announcing completion of a previously disclosed strategic investment by Macquarie Bank Limited. Macquarie acquired 2,346,701 common shares at C$4.26 per share for gross proceeds of approximately C$10,000,000, with proceeds earmarked for advancing the Fenn-Gib gold project in Ontario. Shares carry a four-month-plus-one-day statutory hold period expiring February 15, 2027. This is a routine private placement to a strategic investor, not a change-of-control or special situation; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for TSXV/NYSE American pricing pressure, Macquarie's future intentions, and project permitting milestones.
